changelog:
notion v1.0.0

- Initial release with Notion API integration for creating and managing pages, databases, and blocks.
- Includes unified API with access to 50+ models across providers (Bedrock, OpenAI, Vertex, Replicate, ElevenLabs, Minimax, and more).
- Supports text, image, video, audio (TTS/STT), music generation, web search, document parsing, email, and SMS.
- Features smart routing to automatically select models based on cost or quality.
- Comprehensive bash usage examples and parameter documentation included.
summary: Notion API for creating and managing pages, databases, and blocks. And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text...
